entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling because I need to return something. I ordered an Aero Road Helmet a little while ago and, I don't know, I'm just really disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I just... I was so excited for it, and now I feel terrible.
Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see the Aero Road Helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh no, it's not broken or anything. It's just... the color. It looked so different on the website. I saved up for this, and honestly, the box is still unopened because I can't even bring myself to look at it. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I really needed that money back for other things.

I completely understand how important it is for your gear to be perfect, especially a critical piece of safety equipment. When the color isn't right, it can definitely be a letdown. Let me just check the delivery date to confirm the return eligibility.
Please, I hope you can help. It would mean so much.
Okay, I see it was delivered 32 days ago. Let me just double-check our policy... Yes, according to our system, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you.
Oh, really? You can? Oh, thank you! That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. You've honestly made my day.

Of course, I'm happy to help. I'm generating a prepaid return label and sending it to the email we have on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original shipping box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
That's fantastic. Thank you so much, Diana. You've been wonderful.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
